title: Daiyan Henley being out with a knee injury changes nothing about the failed trade to Broncos

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Daiyan Henley being out with a knee injury changes nothing about the failed trade to Broncos
sources.description: The failed trade of Chargers linebacker Daiyan Henley returned to the front burner on Friday, with the news that Henley will miss Sunday's game against the Jets due to a knee injury.
